propositions: Outbound create mutations must resolve and stamp the target project per ticket rather than using a single construction-time project value, covering both Cloud and Data Center transports
The cross-project validation guard must relax from equality check against one configured project to set membership check against all projects in the store mapping
Stale or typo bindings pointing to projects absent from the store mapping must emit no create mutation to prevent invalid cross-project creates
The reserved _bridge_target_project key must be stamped on the mutation's fields during creation and explicitly dropped before sending to the Jira transport to avoid spurious field errors
Single-project stores without an explicit mapping must preserve backward-compatible behavior by falling back to the single configured project
